Current infra: hybrid cloud (GCP primary), on-prem for EU edge nodes via partner; homegrown embedding service for matchmaking (CPU-based). Looking to consolidate inference path.
Cost posture: very cost-sensitive. Target cost profile: reduce per-conversation token spend by ~40% vs current managed API. Budget requires proof of 30-50% TCO improvement to justify Dedicated pool.

Interest: Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/caching and quantization profiles. Wants automatic KV/prefix caching for repeated player prompts (e.g., starter intents).
Primary decision drivers: latency SLOs, predictable unit economics, deployment flexibility (VPC + EU residency).
